conf.description: Ivanti ICS admin-access JSON filter: deserializes the native JSON export; ECS/custom field mapping is NOT implemented because Ivanti publishes no key names for this filter (see README gap).

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS admin-access, JSON filter. Key names are unpublished; per brief, an unguessable field name is left unmapped rather than guessed. Verifying on-device whether this form promotes the administrator source IP to a structured key (which the WELF mgmt envelope omits entirely) is the specific reason this format is worth a capture. This pipeline deserializes JSON and tags event.dataset only. See ivanti-ics/README.md gaps.

functions.description: record the field-name gap up front
deserialize the JSON record so its native keys become individually queryable
tag the dataset; no other field is safe to map without a firmware capture
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
